preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'chk_form_code_mutual_exclusion' AND conrelid = 'forms'::regclass

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE forms ADD CONSTRAINT chk_form_code_mutual_exclusion CHECK ( (form_code IS NOT NULL AND event_code IS NULL) OR (form_code IS NULL AND event_code IS NOT NULL) OR (form_code IS NULL AND event_code IS NULL) );
